rules.description: Enforce zero deleted historical observations across refreshes.
Ensure all 9 daily wage StatVars share the same latest date.
Ensure MaxDate does not regress below 2025 and stays within MoSPI PLFS annual publication lag.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR) AS max_date_str FROM stats
params.condition: max_date_str >= '2025' AND CAST(SUBSTR(max_date_str, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 2

rules.description: Ensure daily wage values in INR are non-negative.
Ensure each StatVar retains at least the baseline 1,182 observations.
Ensure all 9 daily wage StatisticalVariables are emitted.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StatVar) AS sv_count FROM stats
